title: acilepis kerrii
intro: Acilepis kerrii, commonly known as Thai mountain mint or Thai mint, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Acilepis kerrii are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce stress, and promote a sense of calmness. The bioactive constituents of Acilepis kerrii include volatile oils such as menthone, limonene, and beta-pinene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
